_comment_purpose: FV voice registry (C4). THIS FILE, not the prose docs, is the authoritative roster of adversarial voices. Every hand-maintained roster site (README, INSTALL, the adversarial/code-adversarial SKILLs, scripts/README, dispatch.config.example.json) is generated from here by scripts/gen_roster_docs.py between explicit markers. Edit a voice here, run `gen_roster_docs.py`, and the doc blocks follow. `gen_roster_docs.py --check` fails CI on drift.
_comment_registry_rule: REGISTRY RULE: calibration is the gate. Canonical voices require cited fitness evidence; pending evidence is candidate-only. OMP route calibration is tracked separately and never inferred from historical transports.

voice_fields.id: stable voice slug and per-seat artifact directory name.
voice_fields.model: active OMP provider/model selector; retired entries may retain a historical selector for calibration provenance.
voice_fields.family: provider/model family for diversity accounting at synthesis time (Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / Moonshot / DeepSeek / NVIDIA / Zhipu / Mistral / Alibaba / ...).
voice_fields.harness: omp for active routes; retired for historical-only entries.
voice_fields.provider: OMP provider key for active routes; null for historical-only entries.
voice_fields.default_variant: historical calibration variant label; active OMP dispatch uses omp_thinking_level.
voice_fields.calibration: evidence reference: the run that demonstrated fitness (or the failure that excluded it), cited to where the repo documents it. The literal string 'pending' means no fitness run is documented yet — allowed ONLY for non-canonical status.
voice_fields.requires_env: list of env var names that MUST be set for dispatch to succeed (provider auth). doctor checks these are present. [] when none.
voice_fields.endpoint: local base URL for reachability checks, or null for hosted and retired routes.
voice_fields.added: ISO date the voice entered the registry.
voice_fields.retired: ISO date + reason when status became 'excluded' or the voice left service; null otherwise.
voice_fields.notes: auth caveats, gateway quirks, latency, successor models, anything a runner needs before pinning.
voice_fields.omp_model: OMP ModelRegistry selector consumed by generated route and panel profile artifacts.
voice_fields.omp_calibration: evidence for the exact OMP route, or the literal pending. Pending routes may be exercised but cannot be called calibrated.
voice_fields.omp_route_grade: required when omp_model is present. Exact transport-provenance grade: attested | unattested | degraded | errored | contaminated | not-run. Independent of the fitness gate: only an attested route may carry a cited omp_calibration, but attestation alone does not promote a route.
voice_fields.omp_calibration_note: optional prose for a route whose omp_calibration is 'pending': what a run measured and why it did not earn a citation. The literal omp_route_grade carries the machine meaning; this note explains it but cannot override it.
voice_fields.omp_thinking_level: OMP thinking level for this voice's omp_model. RULE: step down one rung from `max`, or take the TOP rung when that model's ladder has no `max` to step down from (`omp models --json` -> thinking[]). The ladder is a property of the PROVIDER, not the weights: the same model served by two providers may expose different rung names, so the same policy can yield different levels per route -- see the glm-5.2 note. Required when omp_model is present; null means the route exposes no thinking ladder and the dispatch selector carries no `:level` suffix. Dispatch composes `<omp_model>:<omp_thinking_level>`, which overrides the agent wrapper's frontmatter level (OMP resolves effort > selector level > agent frontmatter).
voice_fields.omp_thinking_ladder: the rung list this voice's omp_model actually exposes (`omp models --json` -> thinking[]), recorded so the effort policy is checkable offline and so a provider changing its ladder shows up as drift instead of silently redefining the operating point. Required whenever omp_thinking_level is non-null. THIS IS RECORDED DATA, NOT A PREFERENCE: it must equal the live catalog, and r0 asserts omp_thinking_level is what the one-below-max policy yields on this exact list.

status_values.canonical-panel: in the default milestone panel; REQUIRES non-pending calibration.
status_values.candidate: dispatchable and rostered, but calibration is pending or only partial — eligible to be promoted once a fitness run exists. Doc-pinned voices without a fitness run land here.
status_values.local-specialist: narrow-use local voice (e.g. Lean-only) never in the general adversarial panel.
status_values.excluded: calibration demonstrated unfitness for adversarial spec review; kept here with the reason so it is not re-added by mistake.

profile_fields.name: profile label; a run pins 'panel <name>@<content_hash>'.
profile_fields.voices: ordered list of {id, variant} referencing voice ids above.
profile_fields.content_hash: sha256:<16hex> over the normalized profile (voice id+variant set only; label excluded), computed by scripts/gen_roster_docs.py:profile_content_hash. Recomputed and verified by doctor and tests/r0. A membership or variant change moves the hash, so a pinned 'canonical-4@<hash>' is a frozen, content-addressed panel.
